title_en: Good News (17/20): A Fishing Village Turns to Sustainable Tourism
note_en: 与其 A，不如 B means "rather than A, it's better to B": the speaker weighs two options and rejects the first. 与其继续过度捕鱼，不如发展可持续的旅游业 "Rather than keep overfishing, it would be better to develop sustainable tourism." Note the order: the rejected option comes first with 与其, and the preferred one follows 不如, the reverse of English "I'd rather B than A."
